If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

pumpkin cinnamon roll cookies dough: 1 cup (226g) unsalted butter, softened 1/2 cup (100g) white sugar 1/2 cup packed (100g) light brown sugar 1 whole egg + 2 yolks 1 tsp (4g) vanilla extract 1/2 cup (120g) pumpkin puree 3 cups (375g) ap flour 3/4 tsp (4g) baking soda 1/2 tsp (3g) salt 4 tsp pumpkin spice  *cream together the butter and sugars well then add in the eggs, vanilla, extract, and pumpkin puree. important: press the pumpkin puree between a couple layers of paper towel to get rid of the moisture! in another bowl, whisk the flour, baking soda, salt, and pumpkin spice. pour the dry into the wet and fold to mix. using some plastic wrap or parchment paper. spread the dough evenly. if its too soft and sticky, then set it in the fridge for 30-45 min to firm up a bit. once all flat and even in a large rectangle. spread on the swirl paste (recipe below) as even possible but leaving abut an inch or two on the top. carefully roll into a tight log then set in the fridge at least an hour so that it holds it shape. slice into even pieces and bake at 350 for 12-14 min (time will vary on the size). let cool completely before glazing! swirl paste: 3 tbsp (40g) light brown sugar 1 tbsp (14g) unsalted butter, melted 2 tsp (5g) cinnamon 1/2 tsp (2g) pumpkin spice blend 1/2 tsp (2g) cornstarch pinch of salt *combine everything into a paste and spread on the rectangle flat dough sheet.  vanilla glaze: 1 cup (120g) powdered sugar 1-2 tbsp (15-20g) milk, cream, or water 1/2 tsp (2g) vanilla pinch of salt *mix all together and adjust the consistency with either more powdered sugar or more liquid. brush evenly on the cooled cookies :) #pumpkin #cinnamonroll #cookies #recipe

High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender.  Service with rice and enjoy ❤️ #polloguisado #chickenstew #puertoricanfood #dinnerideas #recetas

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. I just got back into town and realized the fridge was EMPTY and the girls needed lunches and dinners for a busy week of sports. CARAMELIZED ONION & GARLIC CHICKEN PASTA 3 large yellow onions, sliced 2 heads garlic, halved crosswise 4 chicken breasts 4 tbsp olive oil, divided Salt and pepper 1 tsp Italian seasoning ¼ tsp red pepper flakes, optional 2 lb pasta ½ cup heavy cream ½ cup grated Parmesan, plus more to serve 1 cup reserved pasta water Fresh parsley 1. Heat oven to 400°F. Toss onions with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper in a large baking dish. Drizzle garlic with oil, wrap in foil and add to the dish. Roast 25 minutes, stirring onions halfway. 2. Season chicken with remaining oil, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning and red pepper flakes. Nestle into onions and bake 20–25 minutes, until chicken reaches 165°F. If needed, remove chicken and roast onions and garlic longer until golden and soft. 3. Cook pasta in salted water until al dente. Save 1 cup pasta water, then drain. 4. Shred chicken. Squeeze garlic into onions and mash. Stir in cream, Parmesan and ½ cup pasta water. Toss in chicken and pasta, adding more pasta water as needed. Finish with parsley and Parmesan! Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

This Pepper Steak is a simple recipe that can made in under 1 hour for a weeknight dinner. Full recipe is posted below and on my blog (check bio) My cookbook, Let’s Get Into It, is currently on sale at its lowest price on Amazon!  Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

COWBOY BUTTER CHICKEN ALFREDO 🤠🧈🍝  If you know me, you know I LOVE anything cowboy butter! This was a 10/10!! Creamy, cheesy, packed with SO much flavor, and ready in under 30 minutes!  INGREDIENTS: * 2–3 chicken breasts, cubed * 12 oz pasta * 1 tbsp olive oil @getgraza  *4 tbsp butter * 1½ cups heavy whipping cream (+ a splash more if needed) * 1 cup mozzarella cheese * ½ cup parmesan cheese * ½ cup pepper jack cheese * 1 tbsp Dijon mustard SEASONINGS (ALL TO TASTE): * Kinder’s Cowboy Butter Seasoning @Kinder's Flavors *Garlic powder * Onion powder * Italian seasoning * Paprika * Slap Ya Mama @Slap Ya Mama  * Salt & pepper INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. 2. Season cubed chicken with all seasonings. Cook in olive oil until golden and fully cooked (165°F).   3. Transfer chicken to a plate. Italian Dressing Chicken! 🍗  Start by patting the chicken dry, then add it to a bowl and season it really well. I use olive oil as a binder. Place the chicken on an oven-safe dish and bake at 350°F for about 40 minutes. Once it’s out of the oven, coat each piece with Italian dressing, then place it back into the oven at 350°F for another 10–15 minutes, or until it’s nice and caramelized. Mac & Cheese For the mac & cheese, I add a couple tablespoons of butter to a pan and let it melt down. Then I add about 1½ tablespoons of flour and create a roux, mixing until smooth. Next, I add about 1 and a half cups of heavy cream and ½ cup of whole milk. You can add as much as you like depending on how creamy you want it. Mix everything together over low heat, then add your favorite seasonings. Add handfuls of cheese and keep mixing until everything is melted and creamy. Then add about 2 cups of your favorite noodles and mix everything together. Transfer it to an oven-safe dish, top with more cheese. Bake at 350°F for about 30 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. #nostalgia #comfortfood #memories #90s #recipeideas

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

Marry Me Chicken Lasagna Soup Recipe ⬇️  Ingredients Chicken 1½ lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs ¾ tsp Italian seasoning ¾ tsp garlic powder ¾ tsp onion powder ½ tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp kosher salt ½ tsp black pepper Soup ¾ lb sweet Italian sausage 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato oil 1 medium yellow onion, diced 4 garlic cloves, minced ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped 2½ tbsp tomato paste 1 (14.5 oz) can petite diced tomatoes 5 cups low-sodium chicken broth, plus extra as needed ¾ cup heavy cream ¾ cup freshly grated Parmesan 1 Parmesan rind 3 oz baby spinach 8 lasagna noodles, broken ¾ tsp Better Than Bouillon Roasted Garlic Base ¾ tsp dried oregano ⅛ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) Fresh basil 1½ tsp lemon juice Salt and pepper to taste Lemon Ricotta 15 oz whole-milk ricotta ½ cup shredded mozzarella ¼ cup grated Parmesan Zest of 1 lemon 1 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tbsp chopped parsley 1 tbsp chopped basil Salt and pepper to taste Directions Season chicken with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Brown sausage in sun-dried tomato oil. Remove, then sear chicken until golden. Reserve one thigh for topping and chop the rest. Sauté onion in the drippings. Add garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, and tomato paste. Stir in oregano and roasted garlic base. Deglaze with broth, then add diced tomatoes, sausage, chopped chicken, and Parmesan rind. Simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through. Mix all lemon ricotta ingredients and refrigerate until serving. Remove Parmesan rind. Add broken lasagna noodles and simmer until tender, stirring frequently. Add broth if needed. Reduce heat to low. Stir in cream, spinach, Parmesan, fresh basil, and lemon juice. Season to taste. Cube and crisp the reserved chicken in a skillet until golden and fully cooked. Serve with a generous scoop of lemon ricotta, crispy chicken, fresh Parmesan, and basil. Creamy Chicken & Leek Puff Pastry Hand Pies 🥧 My husband made these for dinner earlier this week and I knew right away we had to get this one up on the website ASAP…they’re SO good! The filling is delicious enough to eat on its own, but wrapped in flaky puff pastry...this is my ideal comfort food. Pot pie, but portable! Full recipe is linked in our profile or head straight to https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/chicken-and-leek-hand-pies/ 2 tablespoons butter 1 cup sliced leeks white and pale green parts (1 large leek), halved lengthwise then sliced ¼ in ½ teaspoon kosher salt 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour ½ cup chicken stock 1 cup shredded rotisserie chicken 2 tablespoons sour cream or crème fraîche ¾ teaspoon Dijon mustard 1½ teaspoon fresh tarragon finely chopped 1½ teaspoon fresh thyme finely chopped ¼ teaspoon black pepper 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed but cold 1 egg + 1 teaspoon water, beaten Fresh thyme sprigs  In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the leeks and salt, cooking for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until softened but not browned. If they start to brown, reduce the heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Add the stock, stirring, and simmer for 2 minutes, until it thickens slightly. Turn off the heat and stir in the chicken, sour cream, Dijon, tarragon, thyme, and pepper. Taste for salt and adjust as desired. Chill until fully cold or at least room temperature, about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400˚F and line two sheet pans with parchment paper. If you have enough sheet pans, we like to stack a second sheet pan underneath each one so the bottoms of the pastry don't brown too quickly. On a floured surface, roll each sheet of puff pastry to about 13×13 inches. We use a 3 ½-inch circular cookie cutter for the bottoms – cut 9-10 circles from one sheet of puff pastry (or as many as you can fit). On the other sheet of puff pastry, we use a ~4-inch cookie cutter for the tops. Again, cut out 9-10 circles, or as many as you can fit. Mound 2 tablespoons of cooled filling on each bottom circle of puff pastry, leaving a border around the edges. Brush egg wash all around the border. Top with the slightly bigger top circle, pressing firmly all the way around the edges to make sure it's well sealed and there are no air pockets. Use a fork to firmly crimp the edges together. Optional: use the 3 ½-inch cookie cutter to re-trim the circle so it looks neat! Brush the tops of each pastry with a thin, but even layer of egg wash. Using a sharp paring knife, poke several holes in the top so steam can escape. To decorate with thyme leaves, dip the sprig in some egg wash, then press it onto the top of the pastry. Bake for ~22 minutes, rotating the pan at 15 minutes, until the pastries are deep golden on both the top and bottom. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

videos.caption: Coca-Cola Cake 🥤🍫 This old-fashioned Coca-Cola Cake is rich, incredibly moist, and covered with a warm chocolate frosting that melts right into the cake. Mini marshmallows bake into the batter, giving this nostalgic 9×13 cake an extra-soft texture. You can get the more detailed version with extra tips, step-by-step help, and a printable recipe on my website. Visit my blog through the link in my bio! For the cake: 2 cups all-purpose flour 2 cups granulated sugar ½ teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 cup Coca-Cola 1 cup salted butter ⅓ cup unsweetened cocoa powder ½ cup buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 cup mini marshmallows For the frosting: ½ cup salted butter 3 Tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder 6 Tablespoons Coca-Cola 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3¾ cups powdered sugar 1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts, optional Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish. Whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and baking soda in a large bowl. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the Coca-Cola, butter, and cocoa powder. Heat until the butter melts and the mixture just begins to simmer, whisking occasionally. Pour the hot cocoa mixture into the dry ingredients and whisk until combined. Add the buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla, stirring just until smooth. Fold in the mini marshmallows. Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and bake for 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs. About five minutes before the cake finishes baking, melt the butter with the cocoa powder and Coca-Cola in a saucepan over medium heat. Remove it from the heat and whisk in the vanilla and powdered sugar until smooth. Stir in the nuts, if using. Pour the warm frosting over the warm cake and spread it evenly. Let the frosting set before slicing. #cocacolacake #chocolatecake #southerndessert #oldfashionedrecipes #cakerecipe Coca-Cola cake recipe, old-fashioned Coca-Cola cake, Southern chocolate cake, chocolate sheet cake, 9×13 cake recipe, chocolate cake with warm frosting, nostalgic dessert recipe

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

videos.caption: Sprout is Fauna Robotics’ small, developer-focused humanoid robot built to work safely around people in real-world spaces like labs, schools, offices, retail, and entertainment venues. It’s designed less like a shrunken factory robot and more like a “human-environment” platform: lightweight, padded/soft on the outside, and engineered to reduce impact risk with compliant control and limited joint torques. What makes Sprout interesting is the “full-stack” approach. Fauna positions it as a ready-to-build-on system where core capabilities—movement, perception, navigation, and social expression—work out of the box, so teams can spend time on applications instead of rebuilding fundamentals.  Sprout also leans into interaction: it can be directed via voice, has expressive features (like articulated eyebrows and LED facial elements), and supports things like whole-body control, grippers for manipulation, and even VR-based teleoperation within a unified hardware-software stack.  Pricing reported at launch is about $50,000, targeting researchers, universities, and builders who want a capable humanoid platform without starting from scratch.#ainews #robotics #Techtok #futuretech

✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. There are so many good recipes out there, but truthfully I’ve always had a hard time finding one that actually works for the season of life I’m in. My husband works late and I have two little girls, so weeknight dinner is on me, and most nights I just don’t have the time, the energy, or the headspace for a lot of recipes. That’s pretty much why I started making my own dinners, and I hope other moms, or honestly anyone, can appreciate them, because to me they’re actually so easy. DUMB DINNERS Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo INGREDIENTS 1 box (16 oz) orzo, uncooked 1 tub (32 oz) Panera broccoli cheddar soup 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 3 cups shredded rotisserie chicken 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper a few shakes Frank’s RedHot 1 bag (12 oz) frozen broccoli florets 1 bag (8 oz) shredded extra-sharp cheddar a big handful Cheez-Its, crushed HOW TO MAKE IT Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9×13 dish. Dump in the orzo, soup, broth, and chicken. Sprinkle on the garlic powder, pepper, and hot sauce. Dump in the frozen broccoli straight from the bag. Stir well so the orzo is under the liquid. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375°F for 40 minutes. Uncover and stir. It should look loose and creamy. Stir in half the cheddar. Top with the rest, then the crushed Cheez-Its. Bake uncovered 5 more minutes. Let it sit 10 minutes before serving. Taste before adding any salt. #creatorsearchinsights #easydinnerideas #easyrecipe #easymeal #dinnerideas

Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Serve and ENJOY! . . #garlicparmesan #healthyrecipes #mealprep #sheetpandinner #batchcooking

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

Honey Crispy Chicken Ingredients 	•	2 lbs chicken breasts, cubed 	•	2 eggs, beaten 	•	1 ½ cups cornstarch 	•	2 Tbsp soy sauce 	•	½ tsp black pepper 	•	¼ cup brown sugar 	•	¾ cup butter 	•	3–4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	¼ tsp red pepper flakes 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	½ cup honey 	•	1 Tbsp water 	•	1 Tbsp cornstarch (for slurry) 	•	Vegetable oil, for frying 	•	Steamed white rice, for serving ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. Bring to a gentle boil. 	•	Mix 1 Tbsp water with 1 Tbsp cornstarch in a small bowl to make a slurry. Whisk into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until thickened. 	4.	Combine & Serve: 	•	Add fried chicken to the sauce and toss until coated evenly. 	•	Serve hot over a bed of steamed white rice. #chicken #fyp #fypシ #viral #recipe

Five plants that separate a designed garden from a planted one. Rosemary — most people treat it as a herb. Designers use it as a structural evergreen with silver foliage, late winter bloom, and serious drought tolerance once established. Echinops — steel-blue globe thistle that holds its form into winter. Pollinators love it, it seeds around just enough, and nothing else gives you that texture. White Cloud Nepeta — all the soft billowing habit of catmint, none of the blue. Cleaner in a white or silver palette. Underused because most people don’t know it exists. Mountain Hydrangea (Hydrangea serrata) — more refined than arborescens, lacecap form, better fall color, and it actually performs in part shade without flopping. Blue Mist Fothergilla (Fothergilla gardenii ‘Blue Mist’) — blue-green foliage all season, then flame in fall. Native, compact, and genuinely beautiful. The plant that makes clients ask “what is that?” #gardendesign #landscapedesign

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

Moroccon history edit 🇲🇦☀️ | Song: Baixo Cristal Teclas Morocco, officially the Kingdom of Morocco, is a country located in the northwest corner of Africa. It borders the Atlantic Ocean, the Mediterranean Sea, Algeria, and Western Sahara, making it one of the most strategically located nations on the continent. Its unique position has allowed it to serve as a bridge between Africa, Europe, and the Middle East for thousands of years. Morocco has one of the richest histories in Africa. It was home to the Amazigh (Berber) peoples long before the arrival of Islam in the 7th century. Over the centuries, powerful dynasties such as the Almoravids, Almohads, Saadians, and Alaouites transformed Morocco into one of the strongest states in North Africa. At their height, Moroccan empires ruled territories stretching into modern-day Algeria, Mauritania, Mali, and southern Spain. The country also remained independent from the Ottoman Empire and successfully defended itself against several European invasions. Today, Morocco is known for its diverse landscapes, from the snowy Atlas Mountains to the vast Sahara Desert and its long Atlantic and Mediterranean coastlines. Its cities, including Rabat, Casablanca, Marrakesh, and Fez, are famous for their historic architecture, colorful markets, and rich cultural traditions. Moroccan culture blends Amazigh, Arab, Andalusian, African, and European influences. The country is renowned for its cuisine, traditional craftsmanship, music, and hospitality. Dishes such as tagine and couscous are enjoyed worldwide, while Moroccan mint tea has become a symbol of welcoming guests. In recent decades, Morocco has developed one of Africa's largest economies, with strengths in tourism, agriculture, automotive manufacturing, renewable energy, and phosphate production. The country also gained worldwide recognition when its national football team became the first African nation to reach the FIFA World Cup semifinals in 2022. With over a thousand years of continuous statehood, a rich imperial history, diverse landscapes, and a unique blend of cultures, Morocco remains one of Africa's most influential and historically significant countries. #FYP #Morocco #History #FY #creatorsearchinsights  @🇱🇰✝️ 𝓛𝓪𝓷𝓴𝓪𝓷✝️🇱🇰 (tournament)

fall inspired meal prep that tastes good reheated!! buffalo chicken edition 🍂🔥 High-Protein Buffalo Chicken Pasta Ingredients - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 shallot, minced - 3 cloves garlic, minced - 12 oz uncooked pasta (penne, rotini, shells, etc) - 3½–4 cups chicken bone broth - White meat of 1 rotisserie chicken, shredded (about 3 cups) - ~3/4 cup buffalo sauce (depending on how spicy you like it) — I like @Primal Kitchen Foods  - 1/4 cup half & half - 1/2 cup 2% cottage cheese, blended until smooth - 2-3 tsp ranch seasoning powder - ½ tsp onion powder - Salt and pepper, to taste For topping (optional) * 2–3 green onions, thinly sliced * crumbled blue cheese or drizzle of ranch * extra drizzle of buffalo sauce Instructions 1. Heat olive oil or butter in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Add shallot & minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes 2. Add 3½ cups chicken broth & uncooked pasta. Stir to combine and bring to a gentle boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally. You want a little starchy liquid remaining in the pot!  3. While the pasta cooks, shred the rotisserie chicken & blend the cottage cheese until smooth 4. Once pasta is cooked, stir in shredded rotisserie chicken, ranch seasoning, onion powder, salt & pepper and cook for 2–3 minutes until heated through 5. Reduce heat to low and stir in buffalo sauce and cream. Once warmed, turn off the heat before stirring in blended cottage cheese until fully combined 6. Taste and add additional buffalo sauce, salt, or pepper as desired. If the sauce is too thick, add another splash of milk or broth! 7. Top with sliced green onions, optional blue cheese crumbles, and an extra drizzle of buffalo sauce! #mealprep #onepotmeals #easymealprep #healthymealprep #fallmealideas

You already know this Cowboy Mashed Potato Casserole is gonna be GOOD! 🤠 To get the recipe, click the link in @allrecipes bio or continue reading! ⬇️ Ingredients: cooking spray 6 strips bacon 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 (5 ounce) can evaporated milk or whole milk 2 tablespoons butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided 1 pound ground beef 1 cup chopped onion 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 cup barbecue sauce 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar or pepper Jack cheese 1/4 cup canned French fried onions 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley Directions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place dish on a baking sheet. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Place bacon on a paper towel to drain. Drain all but 1 Tbsp of bacon fat in the skillet. Chop bacon when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain potatoes. Return potatoes back to the pot along with evaporated milk, butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mash potatoes with a potato masher until smooth. Stir 1/4 c chopped bacon into mashed potatoes. Add ground beef, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet with reserved bacon fat. Cook over medium until meat is browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes. Add corn kernels, garlic, and paprika to the skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, remaining 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Spread ground beef mixture in prepared baking dish. Spread potatoes evenly over beef. Sprinkle with cheese, remaining bacon, and French fried onions. Bake until bubbly and cheese is melted, 20-25 minutes. Garnish with parsley. 👨‍🍳: Nicole McLaughlin #cowboycasserole #mashedpotatoes #easydinners #dinnerideas

#recipe #asmr #cooking Nashville Hot Chicken Tenders 🌶️🍗 Prep & Cook Time * Prep Time: 20 mins * Resting Time: 15 mins * Cook Time: 8 mins (Double-Fry) * Yield: 4 servings Ingredients 1. Chicken & Marinade * 1.5 lbs chicken tenderloins * 1 cup buttermilk * 1 egg (creates the egg-protein glue layer) * 1 tsp salt & ½ tsp black pepper * 2 tsp Paprika * 2 tsp Garlic Powder 2. Extra-Crunch Dredge * 1.5 cups all-purpose flour * ¾ cup cornstarch or potato starch  * 1 tsp baking powder * 1 tbsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp onion powder * 1 tbsp smoked paprika 3. Frying Oil * 4–6 cups Peanut Oil (or Beef Tallow) 4. Spicy Red Glaze Extract * ½ cup hot peanut oil (scooped straight from your frying pot) * 2 tbsp Cayenne pepper (for heat & red color) * 2 tbsp Sweet Smoked Paprika (for bright, vibrant crimson dye) * 2 tbsp Brown sugar (adds stickiness and sheen) * 1 tsp Garlic powder * 1 tsp Lemon Juice Step 1: Prep & Wet Marinade 1. Pat chicken tenders completely dry with paper towels. 2. In a bowl, whisk buttermilk, egg, salt, and pepper together. 3. Submerge tenders in the buttermilk mixture while preparing the flour. Step 2: Build the Flaked Dredge 1. In a wide dish, whisk the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika together. 2. Drizzle 2 tablespoons of the liquid buttermilk mixture into your flour bowl. Work it with your fingers to form tiny, shaggy flour clusters (crags). Step 3: Dredge 1. Lift a tender from the buttermilk, letting excess drip off. 2. Press firmly into the flaked flour mixture to coat every crag. 3. Rest: Place breaded tenders on a wire rack and let them rest for 15 minutes at room temperature. Step 4: Double-Fry 1. First Fry (Cook & Dehydrate): Heat peanut oil in a pot to 325°F (160°C). Fry tenders in batches for 4–5 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and rest for 5 minutes. 2. Second Fry: Crank oil heat to 375°F (190°C). Flash-fry tenders for 60–90 seconds until deeply crisp. Drain back on the wire rack. Step 5: Mix the Bright Red Clear Oil Glaze 1. In a heatproof bowl, combine cayenne pepper, smoked paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, and citric acid. 2. Carefully ladle ½ cup of the 375F hot peanut oil from your fry pot directly over the spices. 3. Whisk immediately for 30 seconds. The hot oil activates the spices, dissolving the sugar into a translucent, glowing ruby-red oil glaze with zero cloudy solids. Step 6: Finish & Serve 1. While tenders are piping hot on the wire rack, use a silicone pastry brush to lightly stroke the bright red oil across the crust, or drizzle it over top. 2. Serve immediately open-air (never cover!).

Chicken & Green Bean Stir Fry 🥢🥡 Crispy chicken, tender green beans, and a sweet and savory garlic sauce make this easy stir fry better than takeout! Ingredients: 1.5 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into thin strips 2 Tablespoons cornstarch 1/4 cup soy sauce 3 Tablespoons honey 2 Tablespoons rice vinegar 2 Tablespoons hoisin sauce 1 teaspoon ground ginger 1/4–1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes 2 teaspoons cornstarch 3 Tablespoons toasted sesame oil 1 pound frozen green beans 5–6 scallions, whites & greens separated 8 cloves garlic, finely minced How to Make: 1️⃣ In a medium bowl, toss the chicken with 2 Tablespoons of cornstarch until evenly coated. Set aside. 2️⃣ In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, ground ginger, red pepper flakes, and 2 teaspoons of cornstarch. Set aside. 3️⃣ Heat about half of the sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Working in 2–3 batches, cook the chicken undisturbed for a few minutes to brown, then flip and cook until golden and cooked through, about 5–7 minutes per batch. Remove and set aside, adding more oil as needed. 4️⃣ Reduce the heat to low and add the remaining sesame oil. Add the minced garlic and white parts of the scallions. Sauté for 1–2 minutes until fragrant. 5️⃣ Add the frozen green beans and sauté for 6–8 minutes until tender, increasing the heat to medium if needed. 6️⃣ Return the chicken to the skillet and pour in the prepared sauce. Stir to coat everything evenly and cook for 2–3 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add a splash of water or chicken broth if needed. Garnish with the green parts of the scallions and serve over rice!  📌Save this for an easy, better-than-takeout weeknight dinner! 🍚❤️ #chickenstirfry #greenbeans #easychickenrecipes #weeknightdinner #biteswithbri

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals

Former NBA star Paul Pierce has made a shocking admission that he's 'drowning financially' since losing his job from Fox Sports. According to court documents obtained by TMZ, Pierce claims he is consistently struggling to pay his hefty monthly payments to his ex-wife and children. The documents claim that Paul pays nearly $30,000 per month in child support, as well as a further $20,000 per month in spousal support. In addition, the 2008 NBA Champion spends around $50,000 per month in general bills, including $5,000 in groceries, $7,000 on eating out, $1,000 on clothes, $3,500 on entertainment as well as 'various other expenses'. The documents claim that Pierce's last Fox Sports pay check came in August and also revealed that his average monthly income was around $120,000. The former Boston Celtics star claimed that he currently has $300,000 in the bank, with a further $3 million in property. Pierce is asking the court to terminate his spousal support payments to his ex, Princess Santiago, as well as denying her $50,000 request for legal fees. The update comes after Pierce's lawyer wrote to the court that the ex-NBA star would have 'great difficulty' paying the fees. However, Santiago claimed that Pierce had more than enough money to make the payments. In a previous filing, Santiago claimed Pierce earned 'approximately $195million to $203m in total NBA salary' and that he 'has publicly stated that during his NBA career he made enough money from endorsements that he did not have to use his NBA salary to pay his expenses or generous expenditures on his family, romantic partners and family.' Back in January, when she made the initial filing, Santiago said in a statement: 'I filed for paternity papers after multiple attempts to resolve this privately. Paul Pierce is the father of my son, King, and I am simply asking for a paternity test so the truth can be confirmed.' She added: 'This isn't about drama or attention — it's about accountability and doing what's right for my child.' Since retiring in 2017, the 49-year-old California native has worked as an NBA analyst for two sports cable stations, both of which ultimately fired him. In 2021, Pierce was let go by ESPN after livestreaming himself playing poker with bikini-clad women as the group enjoyed some alcohol and marijuana. The Truth, as he was known during his playing days, resurfaced at FS1 in 2024, where he served as a regular contributor on Undisputed with Skip Bayless. Mix well. * ﻿﻿﻿Stir in fresh cream, parmesan and dried parsley. Cook for a tew minutes until creamy, then allow to cool. * ﻿﻿﻿Divide the filling between 3 tortilla wraps, add mozzarella and fold tightly into rolls. * ﻿﻿﻿Heat a little oil in a pan and cook until golden and crispy on both sides. * ﻿﻿﻿Serve hot with crispy fries and enjoy! Cross posting to 4 accounts has been a little crazy and ya girl needs a breather 😮‍💨 so enjoy! ☺️  ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 If comfort food had a personality, this would be it. Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

Men walk the square with monkeys in chains and snakes with their teeth removed, don’t pay if they confront you 🙊  3️⃣ Where you stay matters. I found my riad on the @cozycozy app, which compared the prices across all the major booking sites. Agoda was £40 vs £45 on Booking.com, saving £35 over 7 nights 🏨  4️⃣ Eat all the street food. Vendors need licences, so it’s clean, fresh and cheap. I reccoemnd trying this sardine salad just off the main square, search “fried fish” on google maps 🍗  5️⃣ Stay safe in the medina. Wear your backpack on your front, watch out for pickpockets, ignore the men on street corners and download offline maps before you arrive 🎒  Save this video for your trip to Morocco 📌 #marrakech #morocco #jemaaelfna #cozycozy #ad
